inlines.v: WITHAL, adverb Withaul. [with and all.] 1. With the rest; together with; likewise; at the same time. If you choose that, then I am yours withal How modest in exception, and withal how terrible in constant resolution! 2. It is sometimes used for with. But the word is not elegant, nor much used.
